note: Name rules are INFERRED (names in tools/data/function_names.csv are INFERRED). They place a function that is statically live into class (b) or pick a recording session; they never drive a drop. Patterns are Python regexes over the lower-case name, matched with re.search.

service.why: Xbox Live or online service path (service is offline since 2010)
System Link or network play needs a second console or a network peer
storage or memory-unit fault path (full, corrupt, removed, failed write)

sessions.title: Profiles and saves
sessions.steps: Create, rename and delete profiles; save, overwrite, load and delete save slots; open the storage screen.

sessions.title: Two-player setup and split screen
sessions.steps: Two controllers: set up a 2-player Story or Arcade game, play in split screen, pause from each pad.

sessions.title: Level start, level end and cutscenes
sessions.steps: Start and finish a Story level twice, watch every cutscene, fail a mission once and retry.

sessions.title: Map Maker pools, weather and explosions
sessions.steps: Map Maker: place many crates and barrels, set weather, test-play and blow everything up.

sessions.title: Dialogs, text entry and settings
sessions.steps: Open every confirm dialog, type names with the on-screen keyboard, change and revert every option page.

sessions.title: Story campaign breadth
sessions.steps: Play Story levels not yet recorded (one level per session), complete every objective, die once at a checkpoint, follow and escort allies.

sessions.title: Arcade game modes breadth
sessions.steps: Arcade: one short round of every game mode with bots, team and free-for-all, change scoring and handicap options.

sessions.title: Weapons and pickups
sessions.steps: Pick up and fire every weapon, primary and secondary fire, reload, zoom, throw grenades and mines, melee.

sessions.title: Vehicles and turrets
sessions.steps: Enter, drive, fire from and leave every vehicle and turret in the Story levels that have them.

sessions.title: Map Maker full editor
sessions.steps: Map Maker: every tile set, place and delete tiles, items, AI and lights, save, load and test the map in every Map Maker mode.

sessions.title: Front-end menu walk
sessions.steps: Visit every front-end page (Story, Arcade, Challenge, League, Extras, Options, Profiles), scroll every list to both ends, open every tab.

sessions.title: Movement, damage and death
sessions.steps: Crouch, climb, fall from height, take every damage type (fire, electric, gas, explosion), die and respawn.

sessions.title: HUD, camera and screen effects
sessions.steps: Trigger every HUD state (low health, low ammo, lock-on, objectives popup), use every camera mode, trigger screen flashes and fades.

sessions.title: Object and world breadth
sessions.steps: Interact with every object type in a level (doors, switches, lifts, terminals, breakables) and visit every room.
